name: Vaktarekullen - Flötemarksön
description: Vaktarekullen to Flötemarksön. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Current official sources use Flötemarksön and state the endpoint has moved from or formerly was Holmen. Tanum ArcGIS uses Flötemarksön (Holmen), while OSM wiki and older Outdooractive/Wikiloc tracks still show Vaktarekullen - Holmen around 17.3-17.5 km.
WST title/API, Naturkartan and Munkedal support Vaktarekullen, while WST body text sometimes uses Vaktarkullen. Vaktarstugan appears as a facility alias.
Official title/API and Naturkartan use Flötemarksön, while the WST GPX filename uses flotemarkssjon.

WST/Naturkartan official geometry computes about 11.869 km and has 373 unique points after de-duplication. OSM relation computes about 12.568 km, is more detailed and follows the same corridor/endpoints with offsets up to about 90 m.

WST Stage 20 returned no dricksvatten category results. Vaktarekullen has spring/well evidence and recent field reports mention a well, but a 2022 Wikiloc report said there was no stream at the cottage.
Access lane reported approximate Kasebo at [58.709826, 11.699649], while facilities/Stage 19 evidence places Kasebo parking/toilet/information near [58.7276, 11.7295].

facilities.name: Vindskydd Stora Holmevatten
facilities.description: Wind shelter on or near the southern shore of Stora Holmevatten with grill/fireplace and viewpoint context. WST recommends a short diversion; sensitive birdlife is noted around Stora Holmevatten. No official toilet or drinking-water category found. WST says bring own firewood.

facilities.name: Sjökärrssjön shelter / rastplats cluster
facilities.description: On-route shelter/rest-place cluster at Sjökärrssjön/Sjökärr. WST text mentions shelter with toilet; facility lane found shelter capacity around 4-5, toilet, grill/fireplace, firewood and swimming/view context. Treat lake water as unknown quality/untreated. Official page says accommodation suggestions are otherwise limited to Vaktarekullen; do not overstate Sjökärr as formal lodging beyond shelter/rest-place evidence.

facilities.name: Flötemarksön endpoint map
facilities.description: Information map at the Stage 20 end / Stage 21 start by the public road. Coordinate should be checked when endpoint parking/road access is finalized.

facilities.name: Kasebo
facilities.description: Road-access/connector point with parking, toilet and information context, useful for reaching Vaktarekullen but not on the Stage 20 main line. OSM toilet says drinking_water=no according to facilities lane. Do not expose as on-route Stage 20 service without connector modeling.
